implementation_notes.audio: Resolve each vocabulary audio_key and dialogue audio_key through the app audio service; text remains complete without audio.
implementation_notes.speech: Use semantic scoring with tolerance for accent variation; require target words and intelligible syntax rather than exact phonetic identity.
implementation_notes.feedback: Show the first relevant explanation only, then offer a retry; log the error tag for review scheduling.
implementation_notes.regional_spanish: Teach ustedes as the broad default plural you; optionally expose vosotros as a recognition note in a later Spain-specific track.
